notes_for_editor: Single source. The staffing names and dates are the site's citations of Bonners Ferry Herald clippings from 1935 and 1936; I did not see the clippings. The site's own text says it cannot find documentation for the lookout beyond the 1936 clipping, so no build date, design or removal date is known. Record: county is null and no source here gives one. Elevation 5,003 ft is 1,525 m; it belongs in elevation_m on the tower record, not in facts. drive_up false is inferred from the hike-in label. firelookout.org's Idaho Boundary County list has no Kootenai Point entry. A trail called Kootenai Point appears in search results near Bonners Ferry; the Trailforks and AllTrails pages refused the fetch, and no source I read ties that trail to the lookout site, so it is left out of the story.
